TextView.android:text:
Tap Start Bubble, then open Old School RuneScape.

Tap the bubble to open or hide a tool.
Drag the bubble to move it.
Long-press the bubble for the tool menu.

Created using intellectual property belonging to Jagex Limited under the terms of Jagex's Fan Content Policy. This content is not endorsed by or affiliated with Jagex.

Item data and icons from the OSRS Wiki DPS calculator (github.com/weirdgloop/osrs-dps-calc).

Farming growth times based on RuneLite's Time Tracking plugin (github.com/runelite/runelite).

Zulrah Helper rotation data and arena layout adapted from the Zulrah Helper RuneLite plugin (github.com/while-loop/runelite-plugins).
